title: acalypha gracilis var. divaricata
intro: Acalypha gracilis var. divaricata, commonly known as the narrow-leaved copperleaf, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Acalypha gracilis var. divaricata include treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
